client_review: Only one lion colourway appears in all supplied photos (tan body, brown mane). Please confirm there are no other lion colours.

The lion in img-068 has a greyer brown mane and black nose; the others have a warmer brown mane and a dark brown (maroon) nose on some. Likely lighting and yarn lots, please confirm it is the same design.
Size ladder: img-083 carries overlay labels XL, Large, Medium, Small, left to right. The img-063 panels show the same lions in the same order but without labels. No centimetre values are recorded.
First pass notes size guesses (S, M, L) on single photos; these are not used as fact. Only img-083 supports a size label.
